title: Laspeyre’s, Paasche’s and Fisher’s Index Number (Calculation Table)
title_hi: लासपेयर, पाशे और फिशर का सूचकांक (गणना तालिका)
title_gu: લાસ્પેયર, પાશે અને ફિશરનો સૂચકાંક (ગણતરી કોષ્ટક)
body:
Continuing from the previous calculation:

| Item | Unit | P0 | q0 | P1 | q1 | P1q0 | P0q0 | P1q1 | P0q1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rice | Kilogram | 39 | 1 | 40 | 1.5 | 40 | 39 | 60 | 58.5 |
| Milk | Litre | 40 | 12 | 44 | 10 | 528 | 480 | 440 | 400 |
| Bread | Kilogram | 45 | 2 | 50 | 1.5 | 100 | 90 | 75 | 67.5 |
| Banana | Dozen | 30 | 2 | 36 | 1.5 | 72 | 60 | 54 | 45 |
| **Total** | | | | | | **740** | **669** | **629** | **571** |

**Laspeyre’s index number:**
$I_L = \frac{\sum P_1 q_0}{\sum P_0 q_0} \times 100 = \frac{740}{669} \times 100 = 110.61$
Thus, there is a rise of $(110.61 - 100) = 10.61\%$ in prices of the year 2016 as compared to the base year 2015.

**Paasche’s index number:**
$I_P = \frac{\sum P_1 q_1}{\sum P_0 q_1} \times 100 = \frac{629}{571} \times 100 = 110.16$
Thus, there is a rise of $(110.16 - 100) = 10.16\%$ in prices of the year 2016 as compared to the base year 2015.

**Fisher’s index number:**
$I_F = \sqrt{I_L \times I_P} = \sqrt{110.61 \times 110.16} = 110.38$
Thus, there is a rise of $(110.38 - 100) = 10.38\%$ in prices of the year 2016 as compared to the base year 2015.

title: Illustration 14: Ideal Index Number
question:
Find the ideal index number for the year 2015 from the following data.

| Item | Base year 2014 Price (₹) | Base year 2014 Quantity | Current year 2015 Price (₹) | Current year 2015 Quantity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 16 | 10 | 20 | 11 |
| B | 20 | 9 | 24 | 9 |
| C | 32 | 16 | 40 | 17 |
explanation:
Fisher’s index number is considered as an ideal index number. So, we will find Fisher’s index number here.
We take P0 and q0 for base year 2014, and P1 and q1 for current year 2015.

| Item | P0 | q0 | P1 | q1 | P1q0 | P0q0 | P1q1 | P0q1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 16 | 10 | 20 | 11 | 200 | 160 | 220 | 176 |
| B | 20 | 9 | 24 | 9 | 216 | 180 | 216 | 180 |
| C | 32 | 16 | 40 | 17 | 640 | 512 | 680 | 544 |
| **Total** | | | | | **1056** | **852** | **1116** | **900** |

$I_F = \sqrt{ \frac{\sum P_1 q_0}{\sum P_0 q_0} \times \frac{\sum P_1 q_1}{\sum P_0 q_1} } \times 100$
$I_F = \sqrt{ \frac{1056}{852} \times \frac{1116}{900} } \times 100$
$I_F = 123.97$
Thus, it can be said that there is (123.97 - 100) = 23.97% rise in the prices in the year 2015 as compared to the year 2014.
explanation_hi:
फिशर के सूचकांक को एक आदर्श सूचकांक माना जाता है। इसलिए, हम यहाँ फिशर का सूचकांक ज्ञात करेंगे।
हम आधार वर्ष 2014 के लिए P0 और q0 लेते हैं, और चालू वर्ष 2015 के लिए P1 और q1 लेते हैं।

योग:
$\sum P_1 q_0$ = 1056, $\sum P_0 q_0$ = 852, $\sum P_1 q_1$ = 1116, $\sum P_0 q_1$ = 900

$I_F = \sqrt{ \frac{1056}{852} \times \frac{1116}{900} } \times 100 = 123.97$
इस प्रकार, कहा जा सकता है कि वर्ष 2014 की तुलना में वर्ष 2015 में कीमतों में 23.97% की वृद्धि हुई है।
explanation_gu:
ફિશરના સૂચકાંકને આદર્શ સૂચકાંક માનવામાં આવે છે. તેથી, આપણે અહીં ફિશરનો સૂચકાંક શોધીશું.
આપણે આધાર વર્ષ 2014 માટે P0 અને q0 લઈએ છીએ, અને ચાલુ વર્ષ 2015 માટે P1 અને q1 લઈએ છીએ.

કુલ:
$\sum P_1 q_0$ = 1056, $\sum P_0 q_0$ = 852, $\sum P_1 q_1$ = 1116, $\sum P_0 q_1$ = 900

$I_F = \sqrt{ \frac{1056}{852} \times \frac{1116}{900} } \times 100 = 123.97$
આમ, કહી શકાય કે વર્ષ 2014 ની સરખામણીમાં વર્ષ 2015 માં કિંમતોમાં 23.97% નો વધારો થયો છે.

title: Illustration 15 (Part 1)
question:

| B | 120 kg | 600 | 140 kg | 700 |
| C | 30 litre | 330 | 20 litre | 200 |
| D | 20 kg | 360 | 15 kg | 300 |
| E | 5 kg | 40 | 5 kg | 50 |

| E | 5 किग्रा | 40 | 5 किग्रा | 50 |
